What’s even more disappointing is that the video was deleted without my confirmation or consent, before I could even verify if it was made properly — which is highly irresponsible.

Despite several follow-ups and repeated requests, I have still not received the final, corrected wedding video. For such a special occasion, this kind of service and carelessness is unacceptable.
